title: Thermometer Reading Gap During Illness
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thermometer:reading
| search illness_id=*
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by illness_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| sort - hours_since
description: Shows which illness episodess have gone quiet for illness monitoring readings.
value: During an active illness, long gaps between readings can hide whether things are improving or escalating.
implementation: Send illness monitoring readings events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of illness episodess with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which illness episodess have gone quiet longer than they should for illness monitoring readings.
